stem.en: The client underwent percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) via the femoral artery. Place the post-procedure nursing actions in order of priority.
stem.zh: 患者接受了经股动脉经皮冠状动脉干预（PCI）。按优先顺序排列术后护理操作。

stem.zh: 区分左心衰竭和右心衰竭的表现。

stem.zh: 根据心电图，心脏的哪个部位受累？

correct.en: ST elevation localized to V3-V4 supports anterior wall myocardial infarction, typically involving the left anterior descending (LAD) artery.
correct.zh: V3-V4 导联局限性 ST 段抬高支持前壁心肌梗死，通常涉及左前降支 (LAD) 动脉。

byChoice.en: Leads II, III, aVF.
byChoice.zh: II, III, aVF 导联。

byChoice.en: Correct for V3-V4 anterior lead involvement.
byChoice.zh: V3-V4 前壁导联受累时这是正确选项。

byChoice.en: Leads I, aVL, V5, V6.
byChoice.zh: I, aVL, V5, V6 导联。

byChoice.en: Septal involvement is more strongly associated with V1-V2.
byChoice.zh: 室间隔受累更常与 V1-V2 导联相关。

testTakingStrategy.en: Associate ECG leads with anatomical locations of the heart.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 将心电图导联与心脏的解剖位置联系起来。

stem.en: The nurse analyzes the new vital signs and lung findings.
stem.zh: 护士分析新的生命体征和肺部发现。

clozeStem.en: The client is exhibiting signs of {{1}}, which requires immediate {{2}} support.
clozeStem.zh: 患者表现出 {{1}} 的迹象，需要立即进行 {{2}} 支持。

correct.en: Hypotension, tachycardia, and pulmonary edema (crackles) in the context of AMI are consistent with cardiogenic shock.
correct.zh: 在 AMI 背景下出现低血压、心动过速和肺水肿（湿啰音），与心源性休克一致。

testTakingStrategy.en: Look for the triad of hypotension, pulmonary congestion, and low cardiac output.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 寻找低血压、肺淤血和低心排血量的三联征。

stem.en: Before the client becomes hypotensive and if no contraindications are present, which medications may be anticipated for initial STEMI care? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 在患者发生低血压之前且无禁忌证时，急性 STEMI 初始处理可能会使用哪些药物？多项选择。

correct.en: Initial STEMI care commonly includes immediate antiplatelet therapy with aspirin plus a P2Y12 inhibitor. Nitroglycerin may be used for ischemic chest pain if not contraindicated, and morphine may be used for severe or persistent ischemic pain when appropriate. Warfarin is not used for acute STEMI stabilization.
correct.zh: STEMI 初始处理通常包括立即给予阿司匹林联合 P2Y12 抑制剂的抗血小板治疗。无禁忌证时可用硝酸甘油缓解缺血性胸痛；对严重或持续性缺血性疼痛，必要时可使用吗啡。华法林不用于急性 STEMI 的初始稳定处理。

byChoice.en: Inhibits platelet aggregation.
byChoice.zh: 抑制血小板聚集。

byChoice.en: P2Y12 inhibitor.
byChoice.zh: P2Y12 抑制剂。

byChoice.en: May be used for severe or persistent ischemic pain when appropriate.
byChoice.zh: 在适当情况下可用于严重或持续性缺血性疼痛。

byChoice.en: May be used for ischemic chest pain when the client is not hypotensive and has no contraindications.
byChoice.zh: 患者无低血压且无禁忌证时，可用于缺血性胸痛。

byChoice.en: Long-term anticoagulant, not for acute STEMI stabilization.
byChoice.zh: 长期抗凝剂，不用于急性 STEMI 稳定。

testTakingStrategy.en: For ACS medication items, pair core antiplatelet therapy with contraindication screening for symptom-relief medications.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到 ACS 用药题时，将核心抗血小板治疗与症状缓解药物的禁忌证筛查结合起来判断。

stem.en: The client underwent percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) via the femoral artery. Place the post-procedure nursing actions in order of priority.
stem.zh: 患者接受了经股动脉经皮冠状动脉干预（PCI）。按优先顺序排列术后护理操作。

options.en: Monitor continuous ECG for rhythm changes
options.zh: 持续监测心电图以观察心律变化

options.en: Check pedal pulses and site for bleeding
options.zh: 检查足背动脉搏动和伤口出血情况

options.en: Ensure bedrest with affected leg straight

options.zh: 每 15 分钟评估一次生命体征

correct.en: Vital signs are first, followed by site assessment (risk of hematoma), ECG monitoring, and positioning.
correct.zh: 生命体征排在第一位，其次是伤口评估（血肿风险）、心电图监测和体位。

byChoice.en: Checking the femoral puncture site for bleeding and hematoma is the second priority to detect early vascular complications.
byChoice.zh: 检查股动脉穿刺部位是否有出血和血肿是第二优先事项，以发现早期血管并发症。

byChoice.en: Ensuring bedrest with the affected leg straight prevents bleeding from the arterial puncture site; it is a critical positioning requirement but comes after initial assessment and monitoring.
byChoice.zh: 确保患肢伸直卧床可以防止动脉穿刺处出血；这是一项关键的体位要求，但排在初始评估和监测之后。

byChoice.en: Monitoring the continuous ECG for rhythm changes helps detect reperfusion arrhythmias or acute re-occlusion, which is a key ongoing safety action.
byChoice.zh: 持续监测心电图的心律变化有助于发现再灌注心律失常或急性再闭塞，这是一项关键的持续安全措施。

byChoice.en: Assessing vital signs is the first priority post-procedure to evaluate hemodynamic stability and detect immediate shock or hemorrhage.
byChoice.zh: 术后评估生命体征是第一优先事项，以评估血流动力学稳定性并发现即刻的休克或出血。

testTakingStrategy.en: Prioritize assessment of hemodynamic stability immediately post-op.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 优先评估术后即刻的血流动力学稳定性。

stem.en: Differentiate findings for left-sided heart failure and right-sided heart failure.
stem.zh: 区分左心衰竭和右心衰竭的表现。

correct.en: Left-sided failure backs up into lungs; right-sided failure backs up into systemic circulation.
correct.zh: 左心衰竭血液回流到肺部；右心衰竭血液回流到体循环。

testTakingStrategy.en: Link the anatomy of blood flow to the site of congestion.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 将血流解剖学与淤血部位联系起来。

stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items about caring for a client with a chest tube.
stem.zh: 查阅患者病历，回答关于护理留置胸腔引流管患者的案例分析题。

title.en: Unfolding case: chest tube to water-seal drainage
title.zh: 情境演变案例：胸腔引流管接水封引流

summary.en: A 58-year-old client is admitted with a spontaneous left pneumothorax and a chest tube is placed and connected to a closed water-seal drainage system with suction.
summary.zh: 一名58岁患者因自发性左侧气胸入院，置入胸腔引流管并连接闭式水封引流系统及负压吸引。

content.en: Left chest tube placed in the 5th intercostal space, mid-axillary line, for spontaneous pneumothorax. Connected to closed drainage with wet suction at -20 cm H2O. Occlusive dressing intact at insertion site. Post-insertion chest x-ray ordered.
content.zh: 因自发性气胸于左侧第5肋间腋中线置入胸腔引流管。连接闭式引流并使用湿式负压吸引,设定为-20 cmH2O。置管处密闭敷料完整。已开具置管后胸部X线检查。

content.en: Water-seal chamber: water level rises and falls with respiration (tidaling). Intermittent bubbling in the water-seal chamber. Suction-control chamber: gentle continuous bubbling. Collection chamber: 30 mL serosanguineous fluid since insertion. No subcutaneous crepitus. SpO2 95% on 2 L nasal cannula.
content.zh: 水封腔:水位随呼吸上下波动(潮汐样波动)。水封腔间歇性气泡。负压控制腔:轻柔持续冒泡。收集腔:置管以来引流30 mL淡血性液体。无皮下捻发感。鼻导管2 L/min吸氧下SpO2 95%。

serialized.zh:
生命体征:
脉搏血氧饱和度 (1000): 95 %

content.en: While repositioning the client, the nurse finds the chest tube has become disconnected from the drainage tubing. The client reports increasing shortness of breath. SpO2 is now 89%.
content.zh: 在为患者翻身时,护士发现胸腔引流管与引流管路脱开连接。患者诉呼吸困难加重。此时SpO2为89%。

serialized.zh:

脉搏血氧饱和度 (1330): 89 %

stem.en: For each chest-drainage finding, indicate whether it is expected for this client or requires immediate follow-up.
stem.zh: 对于每项胸腔引流相关发现,判断其对此患者是否为预期表现,还是需要立即跟进处理。

stem.en: Two hours later the nurse notes new continuous bubbling in the water-seal chamber that was not present before. What does this finding most likely indicate?
stem.zh: 两小时后,护士发现水封腔出现此前没有的持续性冒泡。该发现最可能提示什么?

stem.en: At 1330 the chest tube has disconnected from the drainage tubing and the client is short of breath with an SpO2 of 89%. What is the nurse's immediate priority action?
stem.zh: 在1330,胸腔引流管已与引流管路脱开,患者呼吸困难,SpO2为89%。护士首要的即刻处理措施是什么?

stem.en: The seal is restored and the system reconnected. Which later finding best indicates that the client's pneumothorax is resolving as expected?
stem.zh: 水封已恢复,系统重新连接。以下哪项后续发现最能提示患者的气胸正按预期消退?

stem.en: For each chest-drainage finding, indicate whether it is expected for this client or requires immediate follow-up.
stem.zh: 对于每项胸腔引流相关发现,判断其对此患者是否为预期表现,还是需要立即跟进处理。

rows.en: Tidaling (water level rises/falls with respiration) in the water-seal chamber
rows.zh: 水封腔出现潮汐样波动(水位随呼吸上下波动)

rows.en: Gentle continuous bubbling in the suction-control chamber
rows.zh: 负压控制腔轻柔持续冒泡

rows.en: Intermittent bubbling in the water-seal chamber
200 mL of bright red drainage in 1 hour
rows.zh: 1小时内引流出200 mL鲜红色液体

correct.en: Tidaling reflects pressure changes and can indicate a patent tube. Gentle continuous bubbling in the suction-control chamber is expected with wet suction. Intermittent bubbling in the water-seal chamber can be expected early with a pneumothorax as trapped pleural air evacuates. Bright red drainage of 200 mL/hr is excessive and signals possible hemorrhage requiring immediate provider notification.
correct.zh: 潮汐样波动反映胸腔压力变化,可提示引流管通畅。湿式负压吸引时,负压控制腔轻柔持续冒泡属预期。气胸早期胸腔内积气排出时,水封腔间歇性冒泡可为预期表现。每小时200 mL鲜红色引流量过多,提示可能出血,需立即通知医生。

byChoice.en: Tidaling demonstrates the tube communicates with the pleural space and is patent; it is normal.
byChoice.zh: 潮汐样波动表明引流管与胸膜腔相通且通畅,属正常表现。

byChoice.en: Continuous bubbling in the suction-control chamber (wet suction) simply shows suction is being applied; it is expected.
byChoice.zh: 负压控制腔(湿式吸引)持续冒泡仅表示已施加负压,属预期表现。

byChoice.en: Intermittent water-seal bubbling is expected while a pneumothorax resolves; continuous water-seal bubbling, by contrast, would indicate an air leak.
byChoice.zh: 气胸消退过程中水封腔间歇性冒泡属预期;相反,水封腔持续冒泡才提示存在漏气。

byChoice.en: 200 mL of bright red drainage in 1 hour exceeds the typical alert threshold and suggests active bleeding that must be reported promptly.
byChoice.zh: 1小时引流200 mL鲜红色液体超过常规警戒阈值,提示活动性出血,必须及时报告。

testTakingStrategy.en: Separate drainage-system mechanics that can be expected in a pneumothorax from red-flag findings. Sudden, large, bright-red output is the outlier.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 将气胸中可能预期出现的引流系统机制与危险信号区分开。突发、大量、鲜红色的引流才是异常项。

stem.en: Two hours later the nurse notes new continuous bubbling in the water-seal chamber that was not present before. What does this finding most likely indicate?
stem.zh: 两小时后,护士发现水封腔出现此前没有的持续性冒泡。该发现最可能提示什么?

options.en: The suction pressure is set too low
An air leak in the system or at the insertion site
options.zh: 系统或置管处存在漏气

options.en: Re-expansion of the lung is complete
The tube is kinked or obstructed

correct.en: New or continuous bubbling in the water-seal chamber indicates air is entering the closed system — an air leak, either within the system (loose connection) or at the insertion site. The nurse should assess connections and the dressing and locate the leak.
correct.zh: 水封腔出现新发或持续性冒泡提示有空气进入闭式系统,即存在漏气,可能在系统内(接头松动)或置管处。护士应检查各接头和敷料,定位漏气点。

byChoice.en: Continuous water-seal bubbling means air is being pulled into the system from a leak; this is the correct interpretation.
byChoice.zh: 水封腔持续冒泡意味着空气从漏气处被吸入系统,这是正确的解读。

byChoice.en: Lung re-expansion is marked by cessation of bubbling and of tidaling, not by new continuous bubbling.
byChoice.zh: 肺复张表现为冒泡和潮汐样波动停止,而非出现新的持续冒泡。

byChoice.en: A kinked or obstructed tube would reduce or stop tidaling and drainage, not cause continuous bubbling.
byChoice.zh: 引流管打折或阻塞会减弱或停止潮汐样波动和引流,而不会引起持续冒泡。

byChoice.en: Low suction would reduce bubbling in the suction-control chamber; it does not create new water-seal bubbling.
byChoice.zh: 吸引压力过低会减少负压控制腔的冒泡,而不会在水封腔产生新的冒泡。

testTakingStrategy.en: Memorize the rule: continuous water-seal bubbling = air leak. Intermittent = normal pneumothorax evacuation.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 记住口诀:水封腔持续冒泡=漏气;间歇冒泡=气胸正常排气。

stem.en: At 1330 the chest tube has disconnected from the drainage tubing and the client is short of breath with an SpO2 of 89%. What is the nurse's immediate priority action?
stem.zh: 在1330,胸腔引流管已与引流管路脱开,患者呼吸困难,SpO2为89%。护士首要的即刻处理措施是什么?

options.en: Clamp the chest tube near the insertion site with a padded clamp
options.zh: 用带衬垫的钳子在置管处附近夹闭胸腔引流管

options.en: Submerge the end of the chest tube in a bottle of sterile water to re-establish a water seal
options.zh: 将胸腔引流管末端浸入一瓶无菌水中,重新建立水封

options.en: Lay the client flat and call the rapid response team
options.zh: 让患者平卧并呼叫快速反应小组

options.en: Reconnect the tubing after wiping both ends with an alcohol swab
options.zh: 用酒精棉片擦拭两端后重新连接管路

correct.en: If a chest tube disconnects from the drainage system, the priority is to re-establish a water seal by submerging the open end in sterile water (about 2 cm). This lets pleural air escape while preventing atmospheric air from being drawn back into the pleural space, which would worsen the pneumothorax.
correct.zh: 若胸腔引流管与引流系统脱开,首要措施是将开口端浸入无菌水中(约2 cm)以重新建立水封。这样既能让胸腔内空气排出,又能防止大气空气被吸回胸膜腔而加重气胸。

byChoice.en: Submerging the open end in sterile water immediately restores a one-way water seal and protects against tension pneumothorax; this is the priority.
byChoice.zh: 将开口端浸入无菌水可立即恢复单向水封并防止张力性气胸,是首要措施。

byChoice.en: Prolonged clamping is contraindicated because it traps pleural air and can precipitate a tension pneumothorax.
byChoice.zh: 长时间夹闭属禁忌,因其会使胸腔内空气积聚,可诱发张力性气胸。

byChoice.en: Lying flat does not address the open system, and calling for help is appropriate but secondary to immediately re-establishing the seal.
byChoice.zh: 平卧无法解决系统开放的问题;呼叫支援虽恰当,但次于立即重建水封。

byChoice.en: Reconnecting wastes time and risks introducing contamination; with a contaminated open end the safer immediate action is a sterile water seal.
byChoice.zh: 重新连接既耗时又有污染风险;在末端已被污染的情况下,更安全的即刻措施是建立无菌水封。

testTakingStrategy.en: Disconnection from the system → water seal in sterile water. Tube pulled out of the chest → occlusive dressing taped on three sides. Never clamp for long.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 与系统脱开→将末端浸入无菌水建立水封;引流管从胸壁脱出→用三面固定的密闭敷料覆盖。切勿长时间夹闭。

stem.en: The seal is restored and the system reconnected. Which later finding best indicates that the client's pneumothorax is resolving as expected?
stem.zh: 水封已恢复,系统重新连接。以下哪项后续发现最能提示患者的气胸正按预期消退?

options.en: Continuous bubbling returns in the water-seal chamber
options.zh: 水封腔再次出现持续冒泡

options.en: Subcutaneous crepitus develops around the insertion site
options.zh: 置管处周围出现皮下捻发感

options.en: Tidaling stops and water-seal bubbling ceases, with improved breath sounds and a re-expanded lung on x-ray
options.zh: 潮汐样波动停止、水封腔不再冒泡,呼吸音改善,X线示肺复张

options.en: The collection chamber fills rapidly with bright red fluid
options.zh: 收集腔迅速被鲜红色液体充满

correct.en: As a pneumothorax resolves, the pleural air is fully evacuated: bubbling stops, tidaling ceases (lung is re-expanded against the chest wall), breath sounds improve, and the chest x-ray confirms re-expansion. These together indicate the expected outcome.
correct.zh: 气胸消退时,胸腔内积气被完全排出:冒泡停止,潮汐样波动消失(肺已复张贴向胸壁),呼吸音改善,胸部X线证实肺复张。这些综合表现提示达到预期结局。

byChoice.en: Cessation of bubbling and tidaling with re-expansion on x-ray is the classic picture of a resolved pneumothorax.
byChoice.zh: 冒泡与潮汐样波动停止,加上X线示肺复张,是气胸消退的典型表现。

byChoice.en: Returning continuous bubbling signals a new air leak, not resolution.
byChoice.zh: 再次出现持续冒泡提示新的漏气,而非消退。

byChoice.en: Rapid bright red filling indicates hemorrhage, a complication rather than expected resolution.
byChoice.zh: 迅速充盈鲜红色液体提示出血,属并发症而非预期消退。

byChoice.en: New subcutaneous crepitus suggests air tracking into tissues, a problem requiring follow-up.
byChoice.zh: 新出现的皮下捻发感提示空气进入组织,属需跟进的问题。

testTakingStrategy.en: "Resolved" answers show normal findings trending toward baseline; distractors reintroduce a complication.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 表示"已消退"的答案体现各项指标趋向正常基线;干扰项则重新引入并发症。

stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items about infection prevention for a client with Clostridioides difficile.
stem.zh: 查阅患者病历,回答关于艰难梭菌感染患者感染预防的案例分析题。

title.en: Unfolding case: hospital-acquired C. difficile infection
title.zh: 情境演变案例:医院获得性艰难梭菌感染

summary.en: A 70-year-old client who finished a course of broad-spectrum antibiotics now has frequent watery, foul-smelling diarrhea. A stool test is positive for C. difficile toxin.
summary.zh: 一名70岁患者刚完成一个疗程的广谱抗生素治疗,现出现频繁的水样、恶臭腹泻。粪便检测艰难梭菌毒素呈阳性。

content.en: 8-10 loose, foul-smelling stools per day. Temperature 100.6 °F (38.1 °C), mild abdominal cramping. WBC 14 ×10³/µL. Recently completed clindamycin. Shares a semiprivate room with another client.
content.zh: 每日8-10次稀便,恶臭。体温100.6 °F (38.1 °C),轻度腹部绞痛。白细胞14 ×10³/µL。近期完成克林霉素疗程。与另一名患者同住一间双人病房。

stem.en: Which type of transmission-based precautions should the nurse initiate for this client?
stem.zh: 护士应为该患者启动哪种基于传播途径的隔离措施?

correct.en: C. difficile is transmitted by the fecal-oral route through contact with contaminated hands, surfaces, and equipment, so contact precautions (gown and gloves, private room when possible) are indicated.
correct.zh: 艰难梭菌通过粪-口途径,经接触被污染的手、表面和器械传播,因此应采用接触隔离(穿隔离衣、戴手套,尽量安排单人间)。

byChoice.en: Contact precautions interrupt spread via hands, surfaces, and shared equipment, the route for C. difficile.
byChoice.zh: 接触隔离可阻断经手、表面和共用器械的传播,正是艰难梭菌的传播途径。

byChoice.en: Droplet precautions target organisms spread by large respiratory droplets (e.g., influenza, pertussis), not enteric spores.
byChoice.zh: 飞沫隔离针对经大呼吸道飞沫传播的病原体(如流感、百日咳),而非肠道孢子。

byChoice.en: Airborne precautions are for organisms in small droplet nuclei (e.g., TB, measles), not C. difficile.
byChoice.zh: 空气隔离用于经微小飞沫核传播的病原体(如结核、麻疹),不适用于艰难梭菌。

byChoice.en: Protective isolation shields immunocompromised clients from outside organisms; it does not contain a contagious enteric pathogen.
byChoice.zh: 保护性隔离用于保护免疫低下患者免受外界病原体侵袭,不能控制具有传染性的肠道病原体。

testTakingStrategy.en: Match the route to the precaution: enteric/fecal-oral and skin/wound = contact; cough/large droplet = droplet; tiny airborne nuclei = airborne.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 将传播途径与隔离类型对应:肠道/粪-口及皮肤/伤口=接触;咳嗽/大飞沫=飞沫;微小空气飞沫核=空气。

stem.en: After providing care for this client, how should the nurse perform hand hygiene?
stem.zh: 为该患者提供护理后,护士应如何进行手卫生?

options.en: Use an alcohol-based hand rub only
options.zh: 仅使用含酒精的快速手消毒剂

options.en: Apply alcohol-based hand rub, then don clean gloves
options.zh: 先使用含酒精手消毒剂,再戴干净手套

options.en: Wash hands with soap and water

correct.en: For C. difficile teaching and testing, soap-and-water hand hygiene is preferred after care because spores are not reliably inactivated by alcohol-based hand rubs and mechanical washing helps remove them. Correct glove and gown use remains essential to reduce hand contamination.
correct.zh: 在艰难梭菌相关护理教学和考试中,护理后首选肥皂和流动水进行手卫生,因为酒精类免洗手消毒剂不能可靠灭活芽孢,机械性洗手有助于去除芽孢。正确使用手套和隔离衣仍是减少手部污染的关键。

byChoice.en: Soap-and-water hand hygiene is the preferred NCLEX-safe answer for C. difficile because it mechanically removes spores better than relying on alcohol rub alone.
byChoice.zh: 对于艰难梭菌,肥皂和流动水手卫生是更符合NCLEX安全原则的答案,因为其机械性去除芽孢优于单独依赖酒精擦手。

byChoice.en: Alcohol-based rubs do not inactivate C. difficile spores, so they are insufficient alone.
byChoice.zh: 含酒精手消毒剂不能灭活艰难梭菌孢子,单独使用不充分。

byChoice.en: Starting with alcohol rub fails to remove spores; gloving over contaminated hands does not correct this.
byChoice.zh: 先用酒精手消毒剂无法去除孢子,在污染的手上戴手套也不能弥补。

byChoice.en: Water alone without soap and friction does not reliably remove spores.
byChoice.zh: 仅用清水而无肥皂和摩擦不能可靠去除孢子。

testTakingStrategy.en: Spore-formers (C. difficile, anthrax, norovirus is non-spore but also alcohol-resistant) = soap and water. Alcohol is not sporicidal.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 对于形成孢子的病原体(如艰难梭菌)=肥皂加流动水。酒精不能杀灭孢子。

rows.en: Dons a gown and gloves before entering the room
rows.zh: 进入病房前穿隔离衣并戴手套

rows.en: Uses dedicated (single-client) equipment such as a stethoscope and BP cuff
rows.zh: 使用专用(单一患者)器械,如听诊器和血压计袖带

rows.en: Cleans the room surfaces with a quaternary-ammonium wipe only
rows.zh: 仅用季铵盐类湿巾清洁病房表面

rows.en: Removes gloves and gown and performs hand hygiene before leaving the room
rows.zh: 离开病房前脱去手套和隔离衣并进行手卫生

correct.en: Donning gown and gloves before entry, using dedicated equipment, and removing PPE with hand hygiene before leaving are all correct contact-precaution practices. Routine quaternary-ammonium cleaners are not sporicidal; surfaces must be disinfected with a sporicidal agent such as a chlorine-based (bleach) product.
correct.zh: 进入前穿隔离衣戴手套、使用专用器械,以及离开前脱去个人防护用品并进行手卫生,均为正确的接触隔离做法。常规季铵盐类清洁剂不能杀灭孢子;表面必须使用含氯(漂白剂)等杀孢子消毒剂处理。

byChoice.en: Donning PPE before entry prevents contamination of clothing and skin on contact.
byChoice.zh: 进入前穿戴个人防护用品可防止接触时污染衣物和皮肤。

byChoice.en: Dedicated equipment prevents transferring spores to other clients.
byChoice.zh: 专用器械可防止将孢子传播给其他患者。

byChoice.en: Quaternary-ammonium products are not reliably sporicidal; a chlorine-based disinfectant is required for C. difficile.
byChoice.zh: 季铵盐类产品不能可靠杀灭孢子;艰难梭菌需使用含氯消毒剂。

byChoice.en: Doffing PPE and performing hand hygiene before exit prevents carrying spores out of the room.
byChoice.zh: 离开前脱去防护用品并做手卫生可防止将孢子带出病房。

testTakingStrategy.en: For C. difficile, two details flip many answers: soap-and-water hand hygiene and bleach (chlorine) for surfaces. Standard alcohol/quat products are not enough.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 对于艰难梭菌,两个细节常决定答案对错:用肥皂流动水洗手、用含氯(漂白剂)消毒表面。常规酒精/季铵盐产品不够。

stem.en: Place the steps for removing personal protective equipment (PPE) in the correct order before leaving the client-care area.
stem.zh: 将离开患者护理区域前脱去个人防护用品(PPE)的步骤按正确顺序排列。

options.en: Perform hand hygiene with soap and water after removing PPE
options.zh: 脱去PPE后用肥皂和流动水进行手卫生

correct.en: A safe PPE-removal sequence removes the most contaminated items first: gloves, then eye protection by the clean strap or earpieces, then gown, followed by hand hygiene. For C. difficile teaching, final hand hygiene is performed with soap and water because spores are not reliably removed or inactivated by alcohol rub alone.
correct.zh: 安全脱卸PPE的顺序是先脱污染最重的物品:手套,然后通过清洁的带子或镜腿摘下护目镜/眼罩,再脱隔离衣,最后进行手卫生。对于艰难梭菌护理教学,最后的手卫生使用肥皂和流动水,因为单独使用酒精擦手不能可靠去除或灭活芽孢。

byChoice.en: Gloves are removed first because they are the most heavily contaminated item.
byChoice.zh: 手套污染最重,故最先脱去。

byChoice.en: Eye protection is removed next by the headband/earpieces, avoiding the contaminated front.
byChoice.zh: 随后摘护目镜,应抓头带/镜腿,避免接触污染的正面。

byChoice.en: The gown is removed after, rolled inside-out away from the body.
byChoice.zh: 之后脱隔离衣,将污染面向内卷起,远离身体。

byChoice.en: Hand hygiene is performed last after exiting; for spores it must be soap and water.
byChoice.zh: 最后在离开后进行手卫生;针对孢子必须用肥皂和流动水。

testTakingStrategy.en: For PPE doffing, think contaminated to clean, then hand hygiene. In C. difficile items, choose soap and water when handwashing is tested.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 脱卸PPE时按“由污染到清洁”思路,最后进行手卫生。艰难梭菌题目考到洗手时,选择肥皂和流动水。

Nitroglycerin may be used for ischemic chest pain if not contraindicated, and morphine may be used for severe or persistent ischemic pain when appropriate. Monitoring the continuous ECG for rhythm changes helps detect reperfusion arrhythmias or acute re-occlusion, which is a key ongoing safety action.

Tidaling reflects pressure changes and can indicate a patent tube. Gentle continuous bubbling in the suction-control chamber is expected with wet suction. Intermittent bubbling in the water-seal chamber can be expected early with a pneumothorax as trapped pleural air evacuates. Bright red drainage of 200 mL/hr is excessive and signals possible hemorrhage requiring immediate provider notification.
潮汐样波动反映胸腔压力变化,可提示引流管通畅。湿式负压吸引时,负压控制腔轻柔持续冒泡属预期。气胸早期胸腔内积气排出时,水封腔间歇性冒泡可为预期表现。每小时200 mL鲜红色引流量过多,提示可能出血,需立即通知医生。
Tidaling demonstrates the tube communicates with the pleural space and is patent; it is normal.
潮汐样波动表明引流管与胸膜腔相通且通畅,属正常表现。
Continuous bubbling in the suction-control chamber (wet suction) simply shows suction is being applied; it is expected.
负压控制腔(湿式吸引)持续冒泡仅表示已施加负压,属预期表现。
Intermittent water-seal bubbling is expected while a pneumothorax resolves; continuous water-seal bubbling, by contrast, would indicate an air leak.
气胸消退过程中水封腔间歇性冒泡属预期;相反,水封腔持续冒泡才提示存在漏气。
200 mL of bright red drainage in 1 hour exceeds the typical alert threshold and suggests active bleeding that must be reported promptly.
1小时引流200 mL鲜红色液体超过常规警戒阈值,提示活动性出血,必须及时报告。
Separate drainage-system mechanics that can be expected in a pneumothorax from red-flag findings. Sudden, large, bright-red output is the outlier.
将气胸中可能预期出现的引流系统机制与危险信号区分开。突发、大量、鲜红色的引流才是异常项。
Two hours later the nurse notes new continuous bubbling in the water-seal chamber that was not present before. What does this finding most likely indicate?
两小时后,护士发现水封腔出现此前没有的持续性冒泡。该发现最可能提示什么?
The suction pressure is set too low
吸引压力设置过低
An air leak in the system or at the insertion site
系统或置管处存在漏气
Re-expansion of the lung is complete
肺已完全复张
The tube is kinked or obstructed
引流管打折或阻塞

New or continuous bubbling in the water-seal chamber indicates air is entering the closed system — an air leak, either within the system (loose connection) or at the insertion site. The nurse should assess connections and the dressing and locate the leak.
水封腔出现新发或持续性冒泡提示有空气进入闭式系统,即存在漏气,可能在系统内(接头松动)或置管处。护士应检查各接头和敷料,定位漏气点。
Continuous water-seal bubbling means air is being pulled into the system from a leak; this is the correct interpretation.
水封腔持续冒泡意味着空气从漏气处被吸入系统,这是正确的解读。
Lung re-expansion is marked by cessation of bubbling and of tidaling, not by new continuous bubbling.
肺复张表现为冒泡和潮汐样波动停止,而非出现新的持续冒泡。
A kinked or obstructed tube would reduce or stop tidaling and drainage, not cause continuous bubbling.
引流管打折或阻塞会减弱或停止潮汐样波动和引流,而不会引起持续冒泡。
Low suction would reduce bubbling in the suction-control chamber; it does not create new water-seal bubbling.
吸引压力过低会减少负压控制腔的冒泡,而不会在水封腔产生新的冒泡。
Memorize the rule: continuous water-seal bubbling = air leak. Intermittent = normal pneumothorax evacuation.
记住口诀:水封腔持续冒泡=漏气;间歇冒泡=气胸正常排气。
At 1330 the chest tube has disconnected from the drainage tubing and the client is short of breath with an SpO2 of 89%. What is the nurse's immediate priority action?
在1330,胸腔引流管已与引流管路脱开,患者呼吸困难,SpO2为89%。护士首要的即刻处理措施是什么?
Clamp the chest tube near the insertion site with a padded clamp
用带衬垫的钳子在置管处附近夹闭胸腔引流管
Submerge the end of the chest tube in a bottle of sterile water to re-establish a water seal
将胸腔引流管末端浸入一瓶无菌水中,重新建立水封
Lay the client flat and call the rapid response team
让患者平卧并呼叫快速反应小组
Reconnect the tubing after wiping both ends with an alcohol swab
用酒精棉片擦拭两端后重新连接管路

If a chest tube disconnects from the drainage system, the priority is to re-establish a water seal by submerging the open end in sterile water (about 2 cm). This lets pleural air escape while preventing atmospheric air from being drawn back into the pleural space, which would worsen the pneumothorax.
若胸腔引流管与引流系统脱开,首要措施是将开口端浸入无菌水中(约2 cm)以重新建立水封。这样既能让胸腔内空气排出,又能防止大气空气被吸回胸膜腔而加重气胸。
Submerging the open end in sterile water immediately restores a one-way water seal and protects against tension pneumothorax; this is the priority.
将开口端浸入无菌水可立即恢复单向水封并防止张力性气胸,是首要措施。
Prolonged clamping is contraindicated because it traps pleural air and can precipitate a tension pneumothorax.
长时间夹闭属禁忌,因其会使胸腔内空气积聚,可诱发张力性气胸。
Lying flat does not address the open system, and calling for help is appropriate but secondary to immediately re-establishing the seal.
平卧无法解决系统开放的问题;呼叫支援虽恰当,但次于立即重建水封。
Reconnecting wastes time and risks introducing contamination; with a contaminated open end the safer immediate action is a sterile water seal.
重新连接既耗时又有污染风险;在末端已被污染的情况下,更安全的即刻措施是建立无菌水封。
Disconnection from the system → water seal in sterile water. Tube pulled out of the chest → occlusive dressing taped on three sides. Never clamp for long.
与系统脱开→将末端浸入无菌水建立水封;引流管从胸壁脱出→用三面固定的密闭敷料覆盖。切勿长时间夹闭。
The seal is restored and the system reconnected. Which later finding best indicates that the client's pneumothorax is resolving as expected?
水封已恢复,系统重新连接。以下哪项后续发现最能提示患者的气胸正按预期消退?
Continuous bubbling returns in the water-seal chamber
水封腔再次出现持续冒泡
Subcutaneous crepitus develops around the insertion site
置管处周围出现皮下捻发感
Tidaling stops and water-seal bubbling ceases, with improved breath sounds and a re-expanded lung on x-ray
潮汐样波动停止、水封腔不再冒泡,呼吸音改善,X线示肺复张
The collection chamber fills rapidly with bright red fluid
收集腔迅速被鲜红色液体充满

As a pneumothorax resolves, the pleural air is fully evacuated: bubbling stops, tidaling ceases (lung is re-expanded against the chest wall), breath sounds improve, and the chest x-ray confirms re-expansion. These together indicate the expected outcome.
气胸消退时,胸腔内积气被完全排出:冒泡停止,潮汐样波动消失(肺已复张贴向胸壁),呼吸音改善,胸部X线证实肺复张。这些综合表现提示达到预期结局。
Cessation of bubbling and tidaling with re-expansion on x-ray is the classic picture of a resolved pneumothorax.
冒泡与潮汐样波动停止,加上X线示肺复张,是气胸消退的典型表现。
Returning continuous bubbling signals a new air leak, not resolution.
再次出现持续冒泡提示新的漏气,而非消退。
Rapid bright red filling indicates hemorrhage, a complication rather than expected resolution.
迅速充盈鲜红色液体提示出血,属并发症而非预期消退。
New subcutaneous crepitus suggests air tracking into tissues, a problem requiring follow-up.
新出现的皮下捻发感提示空气进入组织,属需跟进的问题。
"Resolved" answers show normal findings trending toward baseline; distractors reintroduce a complication.
表示"已消退"的答案体现各项指标趋向正常基线;干扰项则重新引入并发症。

C. difficile is transmitted by the fecal-oral route through contact with contaminated hands, surfaces, and equipment, so contact precautions (gown and gloves, private room when possible) are indicated.
艰难梭菌通过粪-口途径,经接触被污染的手、表面和器械传播,因此应采用接触隔离(穿隔离衣、戴手套,尽量安排单人间)。
Contact precautions interrupt spread via hands, surfaces, and shared equipment, the route for C. difficile.
接触隔离可阻断经手、表面和共用器械的传播,正是艰难梭菌的传播途径。
Droplet precautions target organisms spread by large respiratory droplets (e.g., influenza, pertussis), not enteric spores.
飞沫隔离针对经大呼吸道飞沫传播的病原体(如流感、百日咳),而非肠道孢子。
Airborne precautions are for organisms in small droplet nuclei (e.g., TB, measles), not C. difficile.
空气隔离用于经微小飞沫核传播的病原体(如结核、麻疹),不适用于艰难梭菌。
Protective isolation shields immunocompromised clients from outside organisms; it does not contain a contagious enteric pathogen.
保护性隔离用于保护免疫低下患者免受外界病原体侵袭,不能控制具有传染性的肠道病原体。
Match the route to the precaution: enteric/fecal-oral and skin/wound = contact; cough/large droplet = droplet; tiny airborne nuclei = airborne.
将传播途径与隔离类型对应:肠道/粪-口及皮肤/伤口=接触;咳嗽/大飞沫=飞沫;微小空气飞沫核=空气。

For C. difficile teaching and testing, soap-and-water hand hygiene is preferred after care because spores are not reliably inactivated by alcohol-based hand rubs and mechanical washing helps remove them. Correct glove and gown use remains essential to reduce hand contamination.
在艰难梭菌相关护理教学和考试中,护理后首选肥皂和流动水进行手卫生,因为酒精类免洗手消毒剂不能可靠灭活芽孢,机械性洗手有助于去除芽孢。正确使用手套和隔离衣仍是减少手部污染的关键。
Soap-and-water hand hygiene is the preferred NCLEX-safe answer for C. difficile because it mechanically removes spores better than relying on alcohol rub alone.
对于艰难梭菌,肥皂和流动水手卫生是更符合NCLEX安全原则的答案,因为其机械性去除芽孢优于单独依赖酒精擦手。
Alcohol-based rubs do not inactivate C. difficile spores, so they are insufficient alone.
含酒精手消毒剂不能灭活艰难梭菌孢子,单独使用不充分。
Starting with alcohol rub fails to remove spores; gloving over contaminated hands does not correct this.
先用酒精手消毒剂无法去除孢子,在污染的手上戴手套也不能弥补。
Water alone without soap and friction does not reliably remove spores.
仅用清水而无肥皂和摩擦不能可靠去除孢子。
Spore-formers (C. difficile, anthrax, norovirus is non-spore but also alcohol-resistant) = soap and water. Alcohol is not sporicidal.
对于形成孢子的病原体(如艰难梭菌)=肥皂加流动水。酒精不能杀灭孢子。

Donning gown and gloves before entry, using dedicated equipment, and removing PPE with hand hygiene before leaving are all correct contact-precaution practices. Routine quaternary-ammonium cleaners are not sporicidal; surfaces must be disinfected with a sporicidal agent such as a chlorine-based (bleach) product.
进入前穿隔离衣戴手套、使用专用器械,以及离开前脱去个人防护用品并进行手卫生,均为正确的接触隔离做法。常规季铵盐类清洁剂不能杀灭孢子;表面必须使用含氯(漂白剂)等杀孢子消毒剂处理。
Donning PPE before entry prevents contamination of clothing and skin on contact.
进入前穿戴个人防护用品可防止接触时污染衣物和皮肤。
Dedicated equipment prevents transferring spores to other clients.
专用器械可防止将孢子传播给其他患者。
Quaternary-ammonium products are not reliably sporicidal; a chlorine-based disinfectant is required for C. difficile.
季铵盐类产品不能可靠杀灭孢子;艰难梭菌需使用含氯消毒剂。
Doffing PPE and performing hand hygiene before exit prevents carrying spores out of the room.
离开前脱去防护用品并做手卫生可防止将孢子带出病房。
For C. difficile, two details flip many answers: soap-and-water hand hygiene and bleach (chlorine) for surfaces. Standard alcohol/quat products are not enough.
对于艰难梭菌,两个细节常决定答案对错:用肥皂流动水洗手、用含氯(漂白剂)消毒表面。常规酒精/季铵盐产品不够。

Perform hand hygiene with soap and water after removing PPE
脱去PPE后用肥皂和流动水进行手卫生

脱手套
Remove gown
脱隔离衣
Remove eye protection / goggles
摘下护目镜/防护眼罩

A safe PPE-removal sequence removes the most contaminated items first: gloves, then eye protection by the clean strap or earpieces, then gown, followed by hand hygiene. For C. difficile teaching, final hand hygiene is performed with soap and water because spores are not reliably removed or inactivated by alcohol rub alone.
安全脱卸PPE的顺序是先脱污染最重的物品:手套,然后通过清洁的带子或镜腿摘下护目镜/眼罩,再脱隔离衣,最后进行手卫生。对于艰难梭菌护理教学,最后的手卫生使用肥皂和流动水,因为单独使用酒精擦手不能可靠去除或灭活芽孢。
Gloves are removed first because they are the most heavily contaminated item.
手套污染最重,故最先脱去。
Eye protection is removed next by the headband/earpieces, avoiding the contaminated front.
随后摘护目镜,应抓头带/镜腿,避免接触污染的正面。
The gown is removed after, rolled inside-out away from the body.
之后脱隔离衣,将污染面向内卷起,远离身体。
Hand hygiene is performed last after exiting; for spores it must be soap and water.
最后在离开后进行手卫生;针对孢子必须用肥皂和流动水。
For PPE doffing, think contaminated to clean, then hand hygiene. In C. difficile items, choose soap and water when handwashing is tested.
脱卸PPE时按“由污染到清洁”思路,最后进行手卫生。艰难梭菌题目考到洗手时,选择肥皂和流动水。
